title: Transplant status and rejection
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's transplant status or transplant complication only.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for liver transplant.

HPI
Pt is a 75 y.o. female presenting for routine surveillance. She underwent a liver transplant 5 years ago. Pt reports feeling well overall with no complaints of fatigue, jaundice, or abdominal pain. She has remained stable on tacrolimus. History is notable for normal liver tests since transplant. No issues with medication side effects reported.

Medication List
Tacrolimus 1mg BID
Lisinopril 10mg QD

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
CV: RRR, CTAB.
Abd: Soft, non-tender, no organomegaly.
Skin: No new lesions.
Vitals: BP 128/78, HR 72, Temp 98.6F, SpO2 98% on RA.

Assessment
1. Status post liver transplant. Stable.
2. Tacrolimus maintenance.

Plan
1. Continue current tacrolimus dose.
2. Routine labs to monitor liver function and tacrolimus levels.
3. F/u in 6 months.

Electronically signed,
P. O'Brien, PA-C
